title: Search for the Skunk Ape
text: Side mission from Kirk, who is hunting a Bigfoot-like creature he calls Skunk Ape or Mr. Mangrove. Read one of his flyers and call him to start it. PowerPyx lists the reward as $1000. IGN places the meeting point north of Pelican Valley, west of Hamlet and east of Watson Bay.

source.name: PowerPyx
source.quote: Kirk is hunting a bigfoot / sasquatch he calls “Skunk Ape” or “Mr. Mangrove”. He is hunting for him with a drone at night and wants your help.

title: Skunk Ape flyer at Skeeter's bar
text: A Skunk Ape flyer can be read at Skeeter's bar in Hamlet. Reading a flyer and calling Kirk starts the side mission Search for the Skunk Ape. IGN names another flyer just inside the Rusty Anchor bar in Key Lento.

source.name: PowerPyx
source.quote: You can find a flyer in Hamlet at Skeeter’s bar.

title: Skunk Ape (Bigfoot) sightings
text: Eurogamer reports the Skunk Ape in the swamplands near Cottonmouth Lake once free roam opens up, with a second sighting reported south of Watson Bay. VICE points to the Kingfishers camp near the water south of Hamlet. The reports differ and may be separate sightings.

source.name: Eurogamer
source.quote: it can be found in the swamplands near Cottonmouth Lake in Mariana County as soon as free roam opens up

title: Search for Tree Effigies
text: Second mission in Kirk's questline: inspect 3 Tree Effigies in the swamps, in any order. IGN says there are nine in total and you only need to find three.

source.name: PowerPyx
source.quote: To solve the quest you need to inspect 3 Tree Effigies in the swamps. You can find them in any order.

title: UFO abduction encounter
text: Eurogamer describes a random night-time event in Kelly County, on a dirt road near the Starlet Motel safehouse east of Port Gellhorn. Beebom also places it in a rural area east of Port Gellhorn. Eurogamer hedges some of the details, so treat this as a report.

source.name: Eurogamer
source.quote: The UFO encounter is a random night-time event in Kelly County, on a dirt road near the Starlet Motel safehouse east of Port Gellhorn.

title: Cool Dog and Dog Island
text: Stick with Cool Dog, the dog on a jet ski, and he eventually brings you to Dog Island in the southern portion of the Grassrivers region. TheGamer says to go west from Key Lento to find him. VICE reports $1,200 in cash as the reward.

source.name: TheGamer
source.quote: if you stick with Cool Dog he will eventually bring you to Dog Island, which is located in the southern portion of the Grassrivers region

title: Oceanarium night protest
text: Visiting the Oceanarium entrance at night reveals a side quest centred around protestors, according to TheGamer. The Oceanarium is on Barentine Drive, to the east of Catalan Key.

source.name: TheGamer
source.quote: visiting the entrance at night reveals a whole sidequest centred around protestors

title: Ring the Bell!
text: Chapter 1 side mission: after a text from Cal, speak to him at the Rusty Anchor, Key Lento's seafront dive bar. Push Square places the bar in the north-western corner of Key Lento.

source.name: Eurogamer
source.quote: After receiving a text from Cal stating that he's headed to Key Lento's seafront dive bar, the Rusty Anchor, go ahead and speak to him there.

title: Kitty Litter Lab: Balsero
text: One of the labs Tyrone asks you to destroy. Push Square places it between NW 16th St and NW 17th St in Balsero. Look for discarded chemical materials, purple smoke coming out of buildings and cat graffiti nearby.

source.name: Push Square
source.quote: You can also find Kitty Litter Labs by keeping an eye out for discarded chemical materials, purple smoke coming out of buildings, and cat graffiti in the nearby area.

title: Kitty Litter Lab: Salton
text: One of the labs Tyrone asks you to destroy. Push Square places it on SW 7th Ave in Salton. Look for discarded chemical materials, purple smoke coming out of buildings and cat graffiti nearby.

source.name: Push Square
source.quote: You can also find Kitty Litter Labs by keeping an eye out for discarded chemical materials, purple smoke coming out of buildings, and cat graffiti in the nearby area.

title: Kitty Litter Lab: Crosstown
text: One of the labs Tyrone asks you to destroy. Push Square places it on NE 10th St in Crosstown. Look for discarded chemical materials, purple smoke coming out of buildings and cat graffiti nearby.

source.name: Push Square
source.quote: You can also find Kitty Litter Labs by keeping an eye out for discarded chemical materials, purple smoke coming out of buildings, and cat graffiti in the nearby area.

title: Kitty Litter Lab: Rockridge
text: One of the labs Tyrone asks you to destroy. Push Square places it on Santiago Ave in Rockridge. Look for discarded chemical materials, purple smoke coming out of buildings and cat graffiti nearby.

source.name: Push Square
source.quote: You can also find Kitty Litter Labs by keeping an eye out for discarded chemical materials, purple smoke coming out of buildings, and cat graffiti in the nearby area.

title: Kitty Litter Lab: Little Cuba
text: One of the labs Tyrone asks you to destroy. Push Square places it between NW 3rd Ave and I-97 in Little Cuba. Look for discarded chemical materials, purple smoke coming out of buildings and cat graffiti nearby.

source.name: Push Square
source.quote: You can also find Kitty Litter Labs by keeping an eye out for discarded chemical materials, purple smoke coming out of buildings, and cat graffiti in the nearby area.

title: Find the Lost Drugs
text: Optional mission with 4 search zones marked in the swamps; each holds 1-3 drug packages. IGN puts each location at roughly $900 worth of cocaine.

source.name: PowerPyx
source.quote: There will be 4 search zones marked in the swamps. In each area you must locate 1-3 drug packages.

title: Donnie's Lost Drugs
text: Donnie sank his boat off Corsair Key. In the south-east portion of the search area, dive down and look for a sunken boat on the ocean floor, then recover the drugs stashed onboard.

source.name: PowerPyx
source.quote: Brian mentioned that Donnie sank his boat off Corsair Key. Find it and recover the drugs stashed onboard.

title: Hit Avery Pawn
text: Optional robbery of the Avery Pawn shop in Port Gellhorn. PowerPyx lists the take at $1k - $10k.

source.name: PowerPyx
source.quote: Lucia suggested hitting Avery Pawn in Port Gellhorn together. It should have a lot of valuables to steal.

title: Talking parrot's cash stash
text: Behind the Three Sheets liquor store in Key Lento. Approach the generator to spot a small vent near the ground; IGN says it holds $1,366. Three Sheets is just east of Donnie's trailer.

source.name: IGN
source.quote: Approach the generator to spot a small vent near the ground. Interact with the vent to collect your reward: $1,366.

title: Kingfishers: Fishing Shacks
text: IGN says this single camp nets you close to $2,000 and places it north-west of Key Lento. Beebom describes a Kingfisher compound in Grassrivers. The texts do not settle whether these are the same place, so the marker is approximate.

source.name: IGN
source.quote: Done right, this single camp nets you close to $2,000, which is a serious head start this early.

title: Crashed plane
text: IGN describes a crashed plane with a dead pilot inside, marked by smoke rising from a field south of Hamlet. Beebom lists plane crash sites under Grassrivers, so this may not be a fixed spot.

source.name: IGN
source.quote: That's a crashed plane with a dead pilot inside, and it's an easy detour worth taking

title: Warehouse with the Leroy Rook card
text: Beebom describes a warehouse south of Hamlet, around three miles from Jason's house, worth around $13,000 in cash and illegal products, with a collectible card adding another $6,000 in potential value. Single source.

source.name: Beebom
source.quote: This location can provide around $13,000 in cash and illegal products, with the collectible card adding another $6,000 in potential value.

title: Storage building with the Hobo Shotgun
text: Beebom describes an industrial storage building south of Hamlet, toward the highway, with a weapon case containing the Marabunta Grande Hobo Shotgun, a unique weapon variant. Single source.

source.name: Beebom
source.quote: Inside, you will find a weapon case containing the Marabunta Grande Hobo Shotgun, a unique weapon variant that can be recovered from your weapon locker.

title: Rundown motel with a sniper rifle
text: Beebom describes a rundown motel area south of Hamlet where you can find the Kingfisher's Laird 350 Sniper Rifle, a unique sniper. Single source.

source.name: Beebom
source.quote: You will find the Kingfisher’s Laird 350 Sniper Rifle, a unique sniper with excellent accuracy and range.

title: Brooks Boatworks safe codes
text: All three Port Gellhorn safe codes can be found at the Brooks Boatworks Illegal Operation, in the north-eastern section of the region's map. VICE says you can get in through a hole in the fence on the east side of the hideout.

source.name: VICE
source.quote: all three Port Gellhorn safe codes can be found at the Brooks Boatworks Illegal Operation located in the north eastern section of the region’s map

title: Payday Loans Store, Little Cuba
text: A Payday Loans robbery location. PowerPyx lists its take at $15,000 - $25,000.

source.name: PowerPyx
source.quote: #4 – Payday Loans Store – Little Cuba ($15,000 – $25,000)

title: Shipwreck Nuestra Señora del Ocio
text: An underwater discovery you find automatically as part of the story mission Island Dreams. IGN says Kenton buys Doubloons for $400 each.

source.name: Push Square
source.quote: You'll automatically find Nuestra Señora del Ocio in Key Lento, Mariana County as part of the story mission Island Dreams.

title: Cocaine Flamingos, Belpoint
text: Pink flamingo figures that have cocaine packages hidden inside them. PowerPyx lists several on Belpoint island, including at the burning flamingo container on the beach and on the docks in the south-east.

source.name: PowerPyx
source.quote: They are pink flamingo figures that have cocaine packages hidden inside them.

title: Easter egg nest on the tallest radio tower
text: Kotaku reports a literal Easter egg waiting in a nest at the top of the game's tallest radio tower, a climb that takes about six minutes. Only Sportskeeda gives a location, South Vice-Dale County, so the marker is approximate.

source.name: Kotaku
source.quote: One person on Twitter climbed the game’s tallest radio tower, a climb that takes about six minutes, and found a literal Easter egg waiting for them in a nest.

title: Dexter's apartment
text: TheGamer reports Dexter's apartment, from the TV series, on Washington Island in the north-east of Vice-Dale County. TheWrap also places it on Washington Island.

source.name: TheGamer
source.quote: in the Northeast of Vice-Dale County (specifically on Washington Island), you'll be able to come across none other than Dexter's apartment

title: Arthur Morgan's hat
text: At a yard sale on Orchard Avenue in the south of Port Gellhorn. TheGamer reads the hat on sale there as Arthur Morgan's, from Red Dead Redemption 2.

source.name: TheGamer
source.quote: you'll need to head to a yard sale that's taking place on Orchard Avenue in the South of Port Gellhorn

title: 'Leonidan Supremacy' monument
text: A Reddit user spotted a few strange symbols at a monument near Manifest Canyon, with a placard dedicated to "Leonidan Supremacy", TheGamer reports. A player report, not yet independently checked.

source.name: TheGamer
source.quote: Reddit user u/akspree spotted a few strange symbols at a monument near Manifest Canyon, with a placard dedicated to "Leonidan Supremacy."

title: Christmas House
text: Scan the Christmas House for a WAiNK Curiosity. Push Square's route: return to Sunset Dr and continue south-west to the area which connects with Laguna Dr.

source.name: Push Square
source.quote: Then, scan the Christmas House itself for a WAiNK Curiosities

title: Nudist resort
text: In the eastern corner of Watson Bay, near Pelican River, according to TheGamer.

source.name: TheGamer
source.quote: you'll need to head to the eastern corner of Watson Bay, near Pelican River and the Paradise Garage that you can own

title: Mount Kalaga tower code
text: Sportskeeda says a board on top of a tower on Mount Kalaga has the code 69185 written on it, for a wooden shed with a door and a keycode console just below the tower. Single source.

source.name: Sportskeeda
source.quote: Climb on top of the tower, and notice a board that has a code written on it. The code is 69185.

title: Mystery house in Leonard County
text: Sportskeeda lists a specific house among the game's secret locations and says it can be found within Leonard County. Single source, and only the county is given.

source.name: Sportskeeda
source.quote: This specific house can be found in the game now, within Leonard County, as shown in the image below.

title: SOS island
text: Sportskeeda describes an island far west of Grassrivers and Watson Bay with two SOS messages, "Send Beer" and a simple "SOS", and a phone lying on the ground that you can examine. Single source; the island is not named.

source.name: Sportskeeda
source.quote: you will find two SOS messages that say "Send Beer" and a simple "SOS." Additionally, you will find a phone lying on the ground that you can examine.

title: Parachute car with a unique pistol
text: Sportskeeda says: shoot the parachute so the Propeller Car falls down, then pick up the Unique Pistol from the vehicle. It places this on a coastal island slightly north-west of the Mariana County mainland. Single source.

source.name: Sportskeeda
source.quote: Shoot the parachute, allowing the Propeller Car to fall down. Pick up the Unique Pistol from the vehicle.

title: Rhino Tanks at Mile Zero Air Station
text: IGN lists two Rhino Tank locations on the Mile Zero Air Station. The Mile Zero Air Station South Stunt Jump is the only way to get over the unbreakable perimeter fence from the ground near the tanks.

source.name: IGN
source.quote: this is Mile Zero Air Station South Stunt Jump and the ONLY way to get over the unbreakable perimeter fence from the ground near the Tanks

title: Brian's Lockup (fence)
text: Near the south-western tip of Key Lento. IGN says to enter the code 7700 on the keypad near the door to get into the lockup.

source.name: IGN
source.quote: He can be found near the south western tip of Key Lento. You’ll need to enter the code 7700 on the keypad near the door to the lock up in order to enter his lockup.

title: Dunk's trailer (fence)
text: In the middle of Port Gellhorn, inside a trailer park near Freedom Tattoo, according to IGN.

source.name: IGN
source.quote: His trailer can be found in the middle of Port Gellhorn, inside a trailer park near Freedom Tattoo.

title: Yasmani (fence)
text: A fence in Vice City, Little Cuba. PowerPyx says he is still available after the story.

source.name: PowerPyx
source.quote: Yasmani – in Vice City, Little Cuba. Still available after story.

title: Helipad on the hospital roof
text: The Southside medical centre has a helipad on its roof. TheGamer says it can easily be reached by going to the left of the building and taking the stairs up.

source.name: TheGamer
source.quote: This hospital has a helipad on its roof, and it can easily be reached by going to the left of the building and taking the stairs up.

title: Vice City Hospital
text: A hospital you can enter, in Rockridge on the north-west side of Vice City, according to IGN's guide to finding Zombix and Adrenaline.

source.name: IGN
source.quote: A reliable hospital you can enter is the Vice City Hospital in Rockridge on the northwest side of Vice City.

title: Jason's House
text: Drive west on Calypso Ave to Peach Palm Dr to find Jason's House. Push Square notes that its collectibles must be picked up before the end of Chapter 1.

source.name: Push Square
source.quote: drive west on Calypso Ave to Peach Palm Dr when you'll find Jason's House. Note: you must do this before the end of Chapter 1.

title: The Siren's Chest
text: A jewelry store in the south-west section of Key Lento, according to IGN.

source.name: IGN
source.quote: you’ll find yourself at The Siren’s Chest jewelry store in the southwest section of Key Lento

title: Ammu-Nation gun store
text: Gun store: weapons, ammo, body armor and parachutes.

source.name: PowerPyx
source.quote: Ammu-Nations are Gun Shops where you buy weapons, ammo, body armor, and parachutes.
source.note: Position read from the guide's screenshots of the in-game map with the Ammu-Nation filter on.

title: Pay 'n' Spray
text: Repair your vehicle and change its colour to evade the police.

source.name: PowerPyx
source.quote: Pay ‘n’ Sprays are special shops where you can repair your vehicle and change its color to evade the police.
source.note: Position read from the guide's screenshot of the in-game map with the Pay 'n' Spray filter on.
